oscillum, oscillī n.

noun, second declension

swing (apparatus)

Recorded by Traupman and Morgan–Owens for a playground swing. Lewis & Short cites the Vergil line both for the swing and for the little masks hung from trees.

See also swing, push, pump, playground.
